notes.title: Endless Game Mode
notes.content: [p][b]We've added a game mode with unlimited time![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45677089/314b8dfb68a7558b8643b96e95fe728db5fb8f28.png"][/img][/p][p]Now, when starting the game, you can choose one of two modes: [b]Classic[/b] or [b]Endless[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Classic[/b] is the base game in its originally intended form.  [/p][p][b]Endless[/b] is a version of the game without a timer — the same functionality, but now you have the opportunity to try all possible combinations![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us <3[/p]
